# HAProxy — servlet-mapping-push-url

servlet-mapping with PUSH relocated to /VAADIN/push. The push URL resolves against the context, which here is the root, so the frontend already carries it and the config is the same file as servlet-mapping.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/templates/servlet-mapping.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# App at /, with the Vaadin servlet bound to /ui/* instead of the root. Shared
# by servlet-mapping and servlet-mapping-push-url: the relocated push URL
# resolves against the context, which here is the root, so the catch-all
# already carries it.
#
# Hilla does not follow vaadin.url-mapping: /HILLA/* (its push endpoint) and
# /connect/* (browser-callables) stay at the context root whatever the Vaadin
# servlet is mapped to, while the browser asks for them under /ui. So those two
# paths — and only those — are stripped back. See vaadin/hilla#289.
#
# Everything else reaches the backend untouched: /ui/* for the Vaadin servlet
# (including /ui/VAADIN/push), and the root-level resources that stay at the
# root whatever the mapping is — /VAADIN/*, /sw.js, /styles.css,
# /manifest.webmanifest, /icons/*, /images/*, /test-redirect.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80

    acl hilla path_beg /ui/HILLA/
    acl hilla path_beg /ui/connect/
    http-request replace-path ^/ui(/.*) \1 if hilla

    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    server vaadin vaadin:8080
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
